description: Send key issue workflow events to Hermes through a configured outbound webhook, with Mohist-rendered bodies, raw payload fields, optional signing, default notification filtering, docs, and tests.

tasks.title: Implement Hermes issue notification outbound path
tasks.description: Add Hermes notification options, event subscriber, renderer, webhook client, optional HMAC signature, and best-effort failure isolation for approval, failure, completion, and optional start events.
acceptanceCriteria: Approval requested events send payloads with issue number, title, approval stage, suggested action, body, and raw fields.
Workflow failed events send payloads with issue number, title, failure reason, suggested action, body, and raw fields, without stack traces.
Issue completed events send payloads with issue number, title, suggested action, body, and raw fields.
Issue started events are disabled by default and sent only when enabled in configuration.
Missing WebhookUrl disables delivery without loading issue/workflow state or making network calls.
Configured Secret signs the JSON body with X-Mohist-Signature.
Webhook delivery errors are logged/swallowed and do not block workflow execution.
Server implementation uses HTTP only and does not launch Hermes processes.
tasks.output: Server notification module, CloudEvent subscriber, Hermes documentation, and focused server specs.
